command_line:
set -eu
cat > job.R <<'RSCRIPT'
args <- commandArgs(trailingOnly=TRUE)
counts_path <- args[[1]]
map_path <- args[[2]]
layout_path <- args[[3]]

suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(DESeq2))

counts <- read.csv(counts_path, header=TRUE, row.names=1, check.names=FALSE)
layout <- read.csv(layout_path, header=TRUE, check.names=FALSE)
map <- read.delim(map_path, header=TRUE, stringsAsFactors=FALSE, check.names=FALSE)

layout$matrix_id <- gsub('-', '_', layout$SampleID)
keep_groups <- c('DMSO', 'Cisplatin_IC50_CBD_IC50')
coldata <- layout[layout$Group %in% keep_groups, c('matrix_id','Group')]
if (nrow(coldata) != 6) stop('Expected 6 samples for DMSO and Cisplatin_IC50_CBD_IC50')
missing <- setdiff(coldata$matrix_id, colnames(counts))
if (length(missing) > 0) stop(paste('Missing count columns:', paste(missing, collapse=',')))
coldata <- coldata[match(c('3_1','3_2','3_3','9_1','9_2','9_3'), coldata$matrix_id), ]
rownames(coldata) <- coldata$matrix_id
coldata$Group <- factor(coldata$Group, levels=c('DMSO','Cisplatin_IC50_CBD_IC50'))

count_mat <- as.matrix(counts[, rownames(coldata), drop=FALSE])
storage.mode(count_mat) <- 'integer'

dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData=count_mat, colData=coldata, design=~Group)
dds <- DESeq(dds)
res <- results(dds, contrast=c('Group','Cisplatin_IC50_CBD_IC50','DMSO'), alpha=0.05)
res_df <- as.data.frame(res)
res_df$ENSG <- rownames(res_df)
res_df <- res_df[, c('ENSG', setdiff(colnames(res_df), 'ENSG'))]
res_df$gene_name <- map$gene_name[match(res_df$ENSG, map$ENSG)]
write.table(res_df, file='deseq2_results.tsv', sep='\t', quote=FALSE, row.names=FALSE, na='NA')

deg <- res_df[!is.na(res_df$padj) & res_df$padj < 0.05 & !is.na(res_df$log2FoldChange) & abs(res_df$log2FoldChange) >= 0.5, ]
deg <- deg[!is.na(deg$gene_name) & deg$gene_name != '', ]
genes <- unique(deg$gene_name)
writeLines(genes, con='deg_gene_symbols.txt')
summary <- data.frame(
  metric=c('samples','tested_genes','degs_after_threshold','mapped_unique_deg_symbols'),
  value=c(nrow(coldata), nrow(res_df), nrow(deg), length(genes))
)
write.table(summary, file='summary.tsv', sep='\t', quote=FALSE, row.names=FALSE)
